items.title: Meta’s stock is enjoying its best month in 13 years thanks to the company’s hot new AI assistant
items.description: Muse is gaining popularity and helping convince investors that Meta’s AI bets are paying off.

items.title: AT&T’s stock looks like the smartest bet in the wireless sector, analyst says
items.description: An analyst at BNP has taken a positive view of AT&T’s stock, writing that investors should have “little to quibble with on the mobile side.”

items.title: Bitcoin hits an 8-month high — and sends a clear message about risk appetite right now
items.description: The lack of clarity around crypto’s regulatory framework hasn’t stopped bitcoin from surging, as investors haven’t abandoned hopes for clearer U.S. rules.

items.title: My husband and I are in our 50s and have no kids. We have $2 million in IRAs and 401(k)s. Do we really need a will?
items.description: “We have no debt and own our primary home, a vacation home, as well as my mother’s home in another state.”

items.title: As the S&P 500 nears a new record high, there are signs of weakness below the surface
items.description: About 60% of the stocks in the S&P 500 are down more than 20% from their all-time highs.

items.title: These beaten-down stocks could bounce back in January, if history is any guide
items.description: Tax-loss selling is likely to lead these 20 stocks to become artificially depressed in the fourth quarter — and therefore good bets to bounce back in the new year

items.title: ‘She says it’s just money’: My friend pays for everything. I should be grateful, but I can’t stand her anymore.
items.description: “On each of these weekends away, she’s probably spending $500.”

items.title: Novo Nordisk’s stock tumbles as doubts persist about Ozempic maker’s strategy
items.description: The drugmaker, best known for developing weight-loss and diabetes drugs, failed to excite investors hoping for a turnaround.

items.title: Amazon and Shopify make starkly different moves in the brewing battle over AI shopping
items.description: While Amazon is shutting out Meta’s Muse, Shopify is partnering on payment technology with the buzzy AI assistant.

items.title: AMD hits a major milestone as AI stocks blaze higher
items.description: On an intraday basis, AMD became the 14th U.S. company to see its market capitalization top $1 trillion.
